notes: Retail sales pipeline: builds a sales table, computes total_sales = quantity * price, prints it, runs PROC MEANS (sum/mean/max/min), then three PROC SQL group-by aggregations (by product, category, date) and PROC SGPLOT charts. The original defines a RETAIL libname over a local Downloads folder and PROC IMPORTs an external CSV; here the libname points at WORK and the same five columns (date, product, category, quantity, price) are supplied inline via DATALINES so the run is self-contained. Every DATA-step, PROC MEANS, PROC SQL and PROC SGPLOT step is the author's own, unchanged.
